## Precision baseline (the 33 real scan items of 2026-09-03)
Strict relevant (7): SSNHL-efficacy; venous-outflow stenting; CI tinnitus-QoL; pulsatile sigmoid surgery ×2 (surgical treatment; wall-anomaly characteristics); EAE treatment phenotypes; Sun Yat-Sen taVNS trial. Borderline (5): hidden-ABR mechanism; IJV decompression case; IIH review; parotid AVF; UCF hyperacusis trial. Incidental epi (15). Clear false positives (6): glomus case, SAPPHIRE surgical prophylaxis, epileptic vertigo, REAXIS retinoschisis, ultra-processed food, MeNET tumor. → 21% strict / 36% lenient.
